description: Micro web framework for simple apps

slides.title: Minimal App
slides.content:
# The Micro Framework 🌶️

Flask is lightweight. No built-in DB or Auth.

## 5-Line Server
```flask
from flask import Flask
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/")
def hello():
    return "Hello World!"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)
```

slides.title: Routing & Dynamic URLs
Templates (Jinja2)
slides.content:
# Rendering HTML 🎨 Flask uses **Jinja2** (same engine as Django's default). ```flask from flask import render_template @app.route("/hello/") def hello(name): return render_template('hello.html', name=name) ``` **hello.html**: ```html

Hello, {{ name }}!

```
